description: What tools/quality/portal2_material_shots.py checks on each shot of portal2-materials-v1 against the retail reference (reference.json). Tiles: a 16x12 grid of mean colours; a tile matches when every channel is within the tolerance (8-bit sRGB) of retail's; two retail runs match on every tile at 8 except animated goo and tractor-beam tiles (up to 21.5). Regions: a rectangle [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the 1024x768 frame on one feature; mean colour within mean_tolerance, and optionally the contrast ratio (luminance standard deviation, +1 each) and the fraction of dark (luma < 40) or bright (luma > 230) pixels. Every region names the defect it pins. Exemptions name why a difference is not this build's defect.

exempt_native_drops.___error: CTextureManager::ForceAllTexturesIntoHardware's precache draws (ForceTextureIntoHardware binds each texture on the error material and draws a degenerate mesh); nothing a view shows. Every backtrace of these drops (gdb on NoteDroppedMaterial, sp_a2_triple_laser) ends in that path.

beside_core_left.pins: Wheatley held in front of the view (the view model grab controller's C_PlayerHeldObjectClone) is drawn with the world's FOV, as retail does: CViewRender::DrawViewModels draws only C_BaseViewModel entities with the view model FOV. With every view model group renderable at cl_viewmodelfov (50) he was drawn about 2.1x too large and his shell covers this patch of the elevator door and floor

beside_core_right.pins: the right side of the same: background beside the held core at retail's size, the shell of a core drawn with the view model FOV

debris_sky.pins: the hanging chamber debris (models/props_hub/glados_chamber_dest01, models/npcs/glados/glados_temp) uses Portal 2's Black shader, a fogged black silhouette; without the shader the material system drew it with the wireframe error shader, white triangle edges across the sky
the same Black debris seen from the catwalk: silhouettes, not white wireframe

bridge.pins: light bridge (projected_wall_entity, SolidEnergy) drawn; the client crashed drawing it before the paint agent's c_projectedwallentity.cpp fix

void.pins: the void above the chamber (no world, no sky face in view): retail shows white because its projected-texture shadow depth views (r_flashlightdepthtexture 1, CShadowDepthView) leave the clear colour white, so the main view clears to white; retail's r_drawskybox 0 keeps it white. Native Vulkan has no flashlight depth textures (r_flashlightdepthtexture 0), so the view keeps its black clear

observation_glass.pins: observation window glass above the chamber: its env_cubemap reflection (an RGBA16161616F map cubemap) sampled black until native Vulkan uploaded half-float textures

cable_loop.pins: cables (SplineRope) drawn: every rope material used an unknown shader and drew as the error material

emitter_glow.pins: the laser's glow sprite at the emitter (retail: a bright halo where the beam starts)

goo_surface.pins: toxic goo (Water with Portal 2 $flowmap, nature/toxicslime_*): not implemented by the native pipeline, dropped

rust_beams.pins: rusty truss models and the lit exterior behind them: retail dark brown, here brighter and higher contrast (the exterior is blown out)

goo_surface.pins: toxic goo seen from above the pit: here a white slab where retail draws dark goo

observation_glass.pins: observation window (models/props_lab/glasswindow_observation, Refract with $envmapsaturation) and the lit room behind it

floor.pins: ssbump floor tiles (tile/white_floor_tile002a): Portal 2's LightmappedGeneric scales an ssbump's basis weights by 1/sqrt(3); without it (this SDK's shader) the floor is 1.73x retail in linear light (mat_ssbump_normalize)

portal_rim.pins: blue portal A 4 s after it opened: retail draws a thick soft blue glow around the rim; here a thin bright outline with flame bites (PortalRefract stage 2 flames, P2's edge effects)
orange portal B: retail a dim soft orange ring; here a bright yellow flame rim, and the laser seen through the portal as a horizontal line (known view-through-portal laser defect)

beam_column.pins: tractor beam column (C_Trigger_TractorBeam::DrawModel, SolidEnergy effects/tractor_beam*): drawn since the render-bounds fix, but pale and without retail's blue swirl, so dark background shows through

floor.pins: ssbump floor tiles under the tractor beam: 1.73x retail before the ssbump normalization; still about 10% brighter (exposure or the beam's light)
